message.content:
I don’t have access to real‑time clocks, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

* Check the clock on your phone, computer, or smart‑watch.  
* Use an online world‑clock service (e.g., timeanddate.com, worldtimebuddy.com).  
* Ask a voice assistant (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) for “the time in New York.”  

Let me know if you’d like help formatting that information or converting it to another time zone!
